PnlDisplayMode.description: Which figure a paper P&L readout leads with; the other always follows.

oneOf.description: Money in the instrument's own currency.
The move one contract made, with the quantity beside it.
The move times the quantity — the stored figure.

description: What the paper P&L readouts now mean: both figures and their units.

changed.description: Whether this call moved the choice; `false` for a read or a repeat.

chosen.description:
The trader's choice; null defers to the catalog's default (money
where a point value is known, else points per contract).

currency.description: The money's currency; null when no point value is known.

money_source.description: Where the point value came from: `declared` or `config`.

point_value.description: What one point is worth per unit held, as a decimal string.

primary.description: The figure readouts of the chart's symbol lead with.

primary_unit.description: The primary figure's unit, e.g. `BRL`, `pts per contract`.

secondary_unit.description: The figure that always follows it, and its unit.

symbol.description: The chart symbol the units below were resolved for.

title: PnlDisplayResult
